  "phoneNote": "The number-plate call button gives the page a trade-specific identity, but the heavily darkened workshop photo barely registers behind the hero text.",
  "desktopNote": "Oversized headings and the enormous phone-number plate overwhelm the hero, while the towing-region section leaves much of the screen unused.",

  },
  "fixes": [
    "Reduce desktop hero and section-heading sizes substantially, and shrink the number-plate button so the service, location and call action form a compact hierarchy.",
    "Give the workshop photo a clearer crop on phone and use a localized dark gradient rather than darkening the entire image; make the blue call prompt white for stronger contrast.",
    "Turn the desktop towing-region section into a compact two-column block and consolidate the repeated directions links so each section has one purposeful action."
